Moving the same word behind a space collapses it ('Name' in 'resource Group Name' is 4.0 against 12.6 for the glued 'GroupName'), while a compound the model has already memorised adds a further 3-5, so the word-initial piece of a name, plain prose words and spaced-out names are predicted inactive (isolated spikes in licence boilerplate such as 'at your option' are left unexplained).
